voice.summary: Inkwell & Ox sounds like a type foundry that likes to show off in the nicest way: precise about axes and weights, but joyful when a sentence starts to move.
dos: Name the axis and the value when describing type

taglines: Weight is just another way to move
Set it. Then watch it swell
boilerplate: Inkwell & Ox is a type studio that designs and tests variable serif typefaces, publishing numbered specimens that show every weight moving in a single line.

microcopy.error: Weight out of range. Slide back a little.

logo.note: A single wave makes visible the weight ripple the studio sets in motion.
